Title: Finland prays for the return of seat switchers

Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:

Author : Adonai

How do you intend to oust?
Swap seats and take advantage of a new prey low on pool!

How do you intend to keep from being ousted?
Swap seats to take advantage of a weak predator!

What do you want your ready region to look like (ie, how many guys are you planning on getting out)?
3-4 huge minions is achievable, with patience.

What do you want your average turn to look like?
Finns.

What's your metagame like? How do your opponents play?
Just about anything can be seen locally.

What problems have you observed with the deck in play?
The illegality of the political actions makes me sad.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
I think I'd pack some "damage dealers" in there. Antediluvian Awakening, Anarch Revolts.. Just making sure you're not missing the 1 damage that'll kill that new prey of yours (plus it might also kill the next prey altogether).

Suggested inclusions:
- Last Stand - if you're going to snipe that VP, make it worth an extra turn
- Petra Resonance
- Life Boon (cause you NEVER know)

Wrong and Crosswise could be Touch of Clarity.
